name: @godrix/mcp-sonarqube
description: MCP Server for SonarQube integration: code quality analysis, issues, hotspots, and Web API access.

sonarqube_url.title: SonarQube URL
sonarqube_url.description: SonarCloud (https://sonarcloud.io) or SonarQube Server base URL.

sonarqube_token.title: SonarQube token
sonarqube_token.description: Authentication token with Browse permission (or write scope if not read-only).

sonarqube_read_only.title: Read-only mode
sonarqube_read_only.description: When true, blocks write operations via call-sonar-api.
